description: ZTBus provides time-resolved driving missions from two electric city buses, including power, position, odometry and passenger information. The provider is Widmer, Fabio; Ritter, Andreas; Onder, Christopher H.. Geographical and temporal coverage: The Zurich Transit Bus dataset spans several years and more than a thousand missions across seasons, assembled through multiple research projects. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: not stated for the resource; the describing article is CC-BY-4.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
